title: Privacy Policy
intro: This policy explains what data MovaQuest (the web app and the mobile app that uses the same servers) collects, why, who we share it with and how you can control it.

ul: You can watch and answer without an account. Guests don't give us a name or email; their settings and unfinished lessons stay in the browser.
Your voice is recorded only during a pause, while you answer, and only to recognise the word. The recording goes to our server and to the Deepgram speech service. We never use it for advertising.
If you create an account, we store your email, name, settings and learning progress so it is available on every device.
We don't sell personal data and we don't show ads.

blocks.p: Interface language, Spanish level (A1–B2) and trip goal (optional free text up to 200 characters). You set them during onboarding and can change them in your profile. Please don't put sensitive information in the goal field.
Completed lessons and their results, words you have said correctly, answer accuracy and the state of unfinished lessons, so you can continue where you left off.

When the video pauses and you answer by voice, the browser records a short clip (up to 8 seconds). The clip and the expected answer are sent to our server and on to Deepgram, which turns speech into text. We get back only the text, and your browser compares it with the correct answer.

ul: Recording starts only after you allow microphone access and only during a pause. The microphone is not used at any other time.
Voice answers are available to guests too. You can always type the answer instead.
Recordings are used only to recognise your answer. We don't save them to your account or profile.

head: Data
Who can see it
rows: only you; others see only the total count
That you shared a lesson and how (share sheet or copied link)

blocks.p: Reading comments and sharing lessons work without an account; liking, saving and commenting need one.

We may use Google Analytics 4 to understand how the app is used. It receives page views and learning events: which lesson was started or finished, the result of an answer (correct / wrong / unclear), voice or text, number of attempts, hints shown, likes, saves, shares, the chosen recording mode, interface language and level. We never send the text of your answers, audio, email or name to analytics. Google Analytics also collects technical data (device type, browser, approximate location from the IP address) and sets its own cookies (_ga, _ga_*).
With every request our hosting providers (Vercel, Render) automatically process the IP address, User-Agent, time and requested address in server logs to run and protect the service.

ul: Account, profile, progress: while the account exists. After the account is deleted, personal data is deleted or anonymised within {{deletionDays}} days.
Comments: until you delete them or the account is deleted.
Voice recordings: not saved to your account or profile.
Sessions: until you sign out or the session expires.
Analytics: up to {{analyticsMonths}} months.
Server logs: according to the hosting providers' settings, usually up to {{logsDays}} days.

lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority: in Ukraine, the Ukrainian Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights; in the EU, the data protection authority of your country (in Spain, the AEPD).

blocks.p: We answer requests within 30 days and may ask you to confirm that the account is yours. You can revoke microphone access at any time in your browser or phone settings; the app keeps working with typed answers.

Data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS). Passwords are stored only as hashes. The session cookie is not accessible to JavaScript, and state-changing requests are protected with a CSRF token. Only authorised people can access the database. No protection is 100% guaranteed; if a breach threatens your rights, we will notify you and the supervisory authority within the time the law requires.

The service is meant for people aged {{minAge}} and over. We don't knowingly collect data from children under {{minAge}}. If you believe a child has created an account, contact us and we will delete it.
We may update this policy. The date of the current version is shown at the top. We will tell you about significant changes in the app or by email.
